title: Territorial onboarding checkpoints and eng tasks
content:
Executive summary:

This note captures a pragmatic, implementable checklist for bringing a new customer or region live with a territorial data residency requirement. Focus is on the engineering tasks, owner handoffs, telemetry to surface compliance drift, and low-friction operator steps for rollback. Purpose is to be used as the single source-of-truth during onboarding sprints and tabletop drills.

Scope and assumptions:
- Customer wants hard "region pin": all persisted data must remain in a specified territory (e.g., EU-1).
- We assume private deployment (VPC or on-prem) or Dedicated with anchoring option.
- This doc does NOT re-specify legal contract language; it covers technical controls and operational evidence capture.

Key goals:
1) Prevent data at rest leaving declared region.
2) Ensure request routing prefers the pinned region and provides auditable evidence when exceptions occur.
3) Capture minimal but sufficient telemetry for audit (time, decision, operator id, fallback reason).
4) Provide safe rollback and mitigation playbook for failures.

Stakeholder map (who does what):
- Eng-private-deployments (owner): network config, tenancy pin enforcement, CI gates.
- Observability (support): telemetry schema, retention and extraction query.
- Solutions / SE (customer-facing): mapping of customer workloads to pin granularity; acceptance criteria.
- Legal / Compliance: verifies evidence format and retention window.
- Oncall / Operators: runbook steps and operator sign-off for go/no-go.

Minimum technical checklist (sprint-mapped tasks):
- [ ] Region affinity flag implemented on tenant metadata (API + db column) (owner: eng-private-deployments).
- [ ] Routing policy: prefer nodes in tenant region; implement synchronous fallback marker when region unavailable (owner: serving-runtime).
- [ ] Storage placement enforcement: ensure new blobs/keys are created with region tag and saved only to region-local backends (owner: infra-storage).
- [ ] KMS key scoping: per-region keys or KMS alias mapping with documented key locations (owner: security).
- [ ] Ingress/egress filters: block outbound flows from region-local storage to foreign persistent endpoints (owner: platform-engineering).
- [ ] Evidence capture: event schema (see telemetry section) and an extraction query for quarterly audits (owner: observability).
- [ ] Operator safety checks: preflight script that verifies region capacity and network reachability (owner: sre).
- [ ] Migration script: tenant data bootstrap tool with dry-run mode and checksum verification (owner: solutions-engineering).

Telemetry / evidence schema (minimum fields):
- event_id (uuid)
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- tenant_id
- declared_region
- decision (routed | pinned_fallback | external_write_blocked | exception)
- reason_code (string enum)
- source_node_id
- dest_storage_region (if applicable)
- operator_action_id (if manual override)
- correlation_id (request id)

Retention and access:
- Default retention for residency evidence: 7 years (confirm with Legal).
- Access: read by Compliance and SEs via confined query role. No wide export without approval.

Operator runbook excerpts (for oncall use):
1) Preflight (before cutover): run preflight.sh --tenant $TENANT --region EU-1. Wait for green, verify no pending writes outside region.
2) Cutover: set tenant metadata pinned_region=EU-1 via admin API. Monitor telemetry for routing decisions for 10m.
3) If failures (>1% exceptions for 5m): automatically disable non-essential background jobs and open immediate incident (PD-4821).
4) Emergency rollback: set tenant pinned_region=null, mark incident, capture evidence bundle using evidence-extract --tenant $TENANT.

Fallback and exception handling logic (preferred sequence):
1) Best: Serve from pinned region node.
2) If pinned region overloaded/unhealthy but required by SLA: can burst to other capacity within same legal territory (e.g., other EU zones) if contract allows.
3) If no same-territory alternative: block persistence and return explicit 409 with body {"residency_violation":true, "action":"operator_review"}.
4) Manual override: operator can temporarily allow persistence to alternate region only with an operator_action_id and must attach a reason_code and expected TTL.

Risks and mitigations (quick register):
- Risk: silent writes to third-party backup in different region. Mitigation: storage adapters require enforced region tag and a CI test that fails if cross-region writes are possible. Add 'residency smoke' Jenkins job.
- Risk: telemetry gaps during scale events. Mitigation: high-priority observability alerts for missing heartbeat and periodic synthetic audits.
- Risk: KMS misconfiguration exposes keys outside region. Mitigation: KMS policy linter in CI and periodic pentest.

Acceptance criteria for customer sign-off (SWE + SE checklist):
- All writes for tenant have dest_storage_region == declared_region in 99.9% of sampled traces for a 48h window.
- Evidence extraction yields a formatted CSV with >= required fields for audit.
- Operator can perform rollback within documented SLA (15m).
- Legal approves evidence format and retention.

Sprint plan (examples, 2-week sprint cadence):
- Sprint 1: tenant metadata + routing preference + preflight script (PD-4821).
- Sprint 2: storage placement enforcement + KMS mapping + CI linter (RES-1298).
- Sprint 3: telemetry schema + export tooling + operator UI changes.
- Sprint 4: tabletop, synthetic audits, and customer dry-run.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Do we support "soft pins" where ephemeral caches may be outside region but persisted artifacts must remain? (Need legal input).
- What exact retention window does Compliance require for this customer? Default 7 years may be excessive.
- Confirm whether dedicated-hosted customers require edge caching changes; document cost delta.

Links and references:
- JIRA PD-4821: region-affinity-metadata-api (implementation ticket)
- JIRA RES-1298: residency-ci-linter and smoke tests
- GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/region-pin-proto/pull/74 (prototype routing guard)
- Confluence: region-onboarding-playbook-v1 (policy + legal templates)

Appendix: quick operator cheat-sheet (copyable)
- Preflight: ./preflight.sh --tenant $TENANT --region $REGION
- Evidence pull: ./evidence-extract --tenant $TENANT --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-01-31 --out /tmp/evidence.csv
- Force rollback: curl -X POST $ADMIN_API/tenants/$TENANT/unpin -H "X-Operator: $ME" -d '{}'

Draft notes and revision history:
- 2025-11-07: initial outline (Asha).
- 2025-12-18: added telemetry schema and operator steps (Liam).
- 2026-02-28: clarified fallback semantics and sprint plan (Marisol).

Reviewer requests: @legal-team to confirm retention window; @security to review KMS mapping.

-- end of doc
